style_preamble: Flat orthographic perfectly planar game texture filling 100% of the entire square frame edge-to-edge. Stylized 32x32 crisp pixel-art voxel texture, cohesive natural earthy palette, clean pixel clusters, uniform ambient albedo lighting. Strictly NO border, NO frame, NO vignette, NO 3D perspective, NO cube render, NO drop shadows, NO directional lighting gradient, NO text, NO watermark, NO isolated objects.
seamless_suffix: Must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE repeating surface pattern where left/right and top/bottom edges match continuously.
retry_modifiers: CRITICAL: Fill the entire image edge to edge with uniform micro-scale repeating surface detail only. Remove all borders, frames, margins, gradients, and text.
STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC ALBEDO TEXTURE ONLY: zoomed-in flat 2D repeating material pattern, zero macro shapes, zero vignette, completely even brightness across corners and center.
PURE 2D PIXEL ART SURFACE TILE: tight repeating pixel clusters across 100% of the canvas, no edges, no labels, balanced mid-tone contrast.
